parent_protocol.fixed: Same warm20 checkpoint, native features, data partitions, minibatch seeds, FL/FU objectives, LR, 200 FL rounds, 45 requests x 5 steps, five-region channels, bandwidth, head candidates, expansion grid, power0.32W and network RF0.1J. No outcome-dependent tuning.
parent_protocol.shared_control: Both arms estimate the same empirical task curvatures using identical HVP procedure and charge its executed computation. Both use the same joint-update MSE budget epsilon_L^2+epsilon_U^2 and task-distortion limits, head enumeration and BCD solver.
parent_protocol.combined: One real AirComp stream transmits g_L+g_U. Its per-device block energy uses ||g_L+g_U||^2, including the true cross term. One receiver noise stream. No invented separate FL/FU error measurements.
parent_protocol.iq: Two real updates occupy I and Q of one complex AirComp stream. Joint device block power and RF cap include BOTH branches. In addition to the common total-update constraints, individual component-MSE limits apply.
parent_protocol.tolerances: epsilon_a=max(1e-8,0.2*B_a) for active tasks. 2*delta_t=0.5*(epsilon_L^2+epsilon_U^2) after mean-normalizing empirical curvature, inherited from the prior manuscript pilot; not tuned for this comparison.
parent_protocol.accounting: Active FL/FU computation, uplink and broadcasts, circuits and hovering; fixed travel energy excluded. Same model for both. Head-optimizer wall time logged, not converted to hardware energy.
parent_protocol.evaluation: Report retained mR/loss, common-reference and policy-matched forget-set KL, total energy and active delay. Same uniform_after100 retained-only matched reference for both; neither evaluation reference is a training teacher.
parent_protocol.limits: One paired development seed. Empirical HVP curvature is not a certified bound. I/Q separation alone need not improve learning: both finally apply the sum. This isolates radio representation/controllability, not simultaneous versus serial scheduling. Both arms are parallel. No forgetting guarantee or forced winning outcome.

parent_protocol.motivation: Original I/Q C8 component bounds were never >=99% active during joint rounds; C9 was active in all joint rounds. Test whether asymmetric requirements reveal a benefit, without withholding available controls from Combined.
parent_protocol.asymmetry: Hold epsilon_L^2+epsilon_U^2 and the two original C9 budgets fixed at each update. Multiply epsilon_U by ratio and renormalize both epsilons to the same total budget. Thus ratio specifies FU/FL RELATIVE tolerance ratio. Inactive tasks unchanged. Tight FU is ratio0.1 for both datasets.
parent_protocol.channel: Multiply complex channel amplitudes by10^(gain_db/20), identically for both arms. Keep noise, max power, RF caps, deadlines, count grid and all learning rules unchanged.
parent_protocol.noise: Original paired wireless seed; no new training-seed claim. All comparisons are development diagnostics, not statistically confirmed superiority.
parent_protocol.replay: Balanced I/Q must reproduce experiment-A final parameter tensors exactly. Save every joint-round scalar audit and five predetermined joint-update snapshots per dataset (joint indices0,9,18,27,36). No outcome-selected snapshots.
parent_protocol.mapped_control: Construct a single combined stream for EACH I/Q solution with the SAME head, duration and final-noise covariance. x_C=1/(1/x_L+1/x_U) over active branches. Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz gives ||l+u||^2*x_C <= ||l||^2*x_L+||u||^2*x_U per user/block. Couple its single Gaussian to the normalized sum of the two original Gaussians; no sample acceptance/rejection. It must reproduce the I/Q trajectory exactly while using no greater RF power. This is a constructive diagnostic, not an independently optimized deployment algorithm.
parent_protocol.snapshot_scope: Same real VLM gradients, curvature and geometry for both arms at every point. Frozen-update resource sensitivity only; no inference of end-to-end mR from snapshot data. Solver failure is no feasible design found, not proof of mathematical infeasibility.
parent_protocol.primary_outputs: All final retained mR, common/matched forget KL, active energy/delay; component/C9 constraint activity, all failures; constructive noise-equivalence checks. No requirement that I/Q win.

reason: Ratio0.1 had no feasible I/Q design at the first FU transaction on either dataset. The registered frozen-update grid showed ratio0.25 feasible for all five regional snapshots of both datasets at0dB. Run this same shared moderate setting end-to-end for BOTH methods. Selected using feasibility, before its mR/KL outcomes; adaptive development, not independent confirmation.
fixed: Only FU relative tolerance ratio changes from the original balanced case; keep total MSE/C9 budgets, learning, hardware, geometry, seed and workload unchanged.
